About the Project

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company developing innovative digital health solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Tech Lead / Senior Full Stack Engineer to help define and build a new patient-facing digital health application.

This role combines hands-on full stack development, software architecture, technical discovery, and product thinking.

The engineer will work closely with key stakeholders to understand product needs, define the MVP, propose technical solutions, identify risks, estimate development efforts, and take ownership of the solution from early-stage discovery through production.

The ideal candidate has strong experience building and launching digital health products, working with sensitive healthcare data, developing cloud-based applications, and integrating external APIs and health data platforms.

Experience with wearable integrations, healthcare interoperability, and U.S. healthcare environments is highly valuable.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery and translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
    • Define the architecture and technical approach for a new patient-facing digital health application.
    • Help define the MVP, technical scope, priorities, estimates, dependencies, and risks.
    • Design and develop full stack functionality across the product.
    • Build and integrate external APIs and healthcare data services.
    • Design secure solutions for handling sensitive patient and health information.
    • Support integrations with wearable devices and/or health data platforms.
    • Collaborate directly with client stakeholders to clarify requirements and recommend technical solutions.
    • Make architectural decisions balancing scalability, security, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
    • Take ownership of technical delivery from discovery through development, testing, deployment, and production.
    • Collaborate with Backend, Frontend/Mobile, Product Design, QA, and Cloud/Security resources as needed.
    • Contribute to the definition of the engineering team and technical roadmap as the product evolves.

Requirements

  • Strong professional experience as a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, or similar hands-on technical role.
    • Proven experience building and launching software products from early stages through production.
    • Professional experience with Digital Health, HealthTech, healthcare applications, or patient-facing healthcare products.
    • Strong hands-on full stack software development experience.
    • Experience designing and implementing cloud-based application architectures.
    • Strong experience integrating third-party APIs and external platforms.
    • Experience working with sensitive healthcare data.
    • Experience working with HIPAA requirements and protected health information (PHI) in U.S. healthcare environments.
    • Ability to conduct technical discovery, define an MVP, estimate development efforts, and identify technical risks.
    • Strong ownership, autonomy, and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to communicate directly with client stakeholders and translate business needs into technical solutions.
    • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience integrating wearable devices or health data platforms such as Apple HealthKit, Apple Health, Health Connect, Fitbit, Garmin, or similar technologies.
    • Experience with FHIR, HL7, EHR, and/or EMR integrations.
    • Experience building mobile healthcare applications.
    • Experience working in startup, early-stage, or 0-to-1 product environments.
    • Experience working directly with founders or senior product stakeholders.
    • Experience defining and delivering MVPs for digital health products.
    • Strong knowledge of healthcare security, privacy, and compliance best practices.

VP, Sales – Health Plans

📍 Remote, US-Based

✈️ Travel: 20–25%

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

The difference you’ll make:

At Midi Health, we’re building the leading virtual care clinic for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, and other midlife health challenges—and we’re growing fast.

We deliver expert, insurance-covered care nationwide and partner with leading health plans and employers to make comprehensive midlife care accessible at scale.

We’re hiring our first VP, Sales – Health Plans to build and scale our payer growth engine nationally. You’ll own how Midi wins and grows partnerships across Blues plans and national and regional payers, from GTM strategy and pipeline development through contracting and expansion.

This is a builder-and-closer role. You’ll personally drive our most important payer opportunities while creating the strategy, team, and sales discipline required to take the business from early traction to meaningful national scale.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the Health Plan GTM strategy. Define target markets, segmentation, pricing and contracting approach, and the roadmap for scaling Midi’s payer business.
  • Win new payer partnerships. Build relationships and drive complex enterprise sales cycles with Blues plans and other commercial payers, from initial engagement through contracting and launch.
  • Grow strategic accounts. Expand existing partnerships across covered lives, geographies, clinical programs, and revenue, building deep relationships with senior payer stakeholders.
  • Deliver against revenue goals. Own the health plan sales target and build the pipeline, forecasting discipline, and operating cadence required to consistently deliver predictable growth.
  • Build and lead the team. Hire, coach, and scale a high-performing payer sales organization as the business grows.
  • Shape Midi’s payer strategy. Bring market and competitive insights back into the business and partner closely with Payer Alliances, Commercial Operations, Clinical, Product, Finance, and Marketing to strengthen our offering and accelerate growth.
  • Represent Midi externally. Build credibility with payer executives and establish Midi as a category leader in women’s midlife care.

Who you are:

  • You bring 12+ years of progressive experience in payer sales, business development, or partnerships, ideally within health tech, provider services, care delivery, or value-based care.
  • You have deep experience selling into health plans, particularly Blue Cross Blue Shield regional plans, and understand how to navigate complex payer organizations and decision-making processes.
  • You have a track record of closing multi-million-dollar payer partnerships and consistently delivering against ambitious revenue targets.
  • You’re both a strategic operator and hands-on closer—comfortable setting the GTM strategy and personally driving a critical deal across the finish line.
  • You’ve helped take a payer GTM motion from early traction to meaningful scale, building the processes, relationships, and teams required along the way.
  • You have strong executive presence and know how to build multi-threaded relationships with C-level stakeholders across complex organizations.
  • You thrive in high-growth environments: self-directed, resourceful, fast-moving, and energized by building through ambiguity.
  • Experience with value-based or risk-aligned partnerships is a strong plus.
  • You’re passionate about improving healthcare for women and excited by Midi’s mission.

Why you’ll love working at Midi:

  • Build a category-defining company transforming how healthcare serves women in midlife.
  • Own a critical growth channel with direct impact on patient access and Midi’s commercial growth.
  • Build from early traction to national scale in a market with significant opportunity ahead.
  • Share in the upside through competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
  • Work with a mission-driven, high-ownership team across the US.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Google Ventures, Semper Virens, and Emerson Collective, trusted by leading health plans and employers, and growing rapidly to meet nationwide demand.

Our mission is simple: change the way healthcare serves women in midlife—because women deserve better.

The salary for this role is 220,000 -284,000 annually. Final compensation will depend on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for additional compensation, including equity and benefits.

At this time, Midi is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

Please note that all official communication from Midi Health will come from an @joinmidi.com email address. We will never ask for payment of any kind during the application or hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Midi Health, please report it immediately by emailing us at .

Our compensation philosophy is based on fair, objective criteria and the impact of the role, regardless of an applicant’s salary history.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to help build our Occupational Health bet inside New Ventures based in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Occupational health is one of the largest, most regulated, and most stubbornly analog corners of corporate wellbeing. In Brazil alone, it is a multi-billion real market: every company is legally required to run occupational exams, manage regulatory compliance (NR-01 and the new psychosocial-risk mandate, eSocial reporting), and look after the health of its workforce. Yet the industry still runs on paper, manual scheduling, fragmented clinics, and reports nobody reads. We intend to rebuild it, at AI speed.

You will partner directly with the Founder/GM of the Occupational Health bet as the product lead of a small, single-threaded squad. This is a 0-to-1 build: the thesis is set, the market is chosen, but the product, the workflow, and the operating model are still being invented. You report to the VP Product, New Ventures, and you'll work daily with the Founder/GM, design and engineering craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents to take this bet from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, first paying customers, and scale.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own product for the Occupational Health bet: translate the Founder/GM's commercial thesis and market insight into product requirements, sequencing, and a roadmap that gets us to paying customers fast, and keep reshaping it as we learn.
  • Redefine the workflow, don't digitize the paperwork: question every legacy step, the manual exam booking, the paper ASO, the compliance theater, and rebuild it around the member, the company, and AI. A faster PDF is not the answer.
  • Make AI the core mechanic, not a feature: work with engineering to embed AI into scheduling, triage, compliance reporting, and the back office, so a lean squad can do what an incumbent's much larger operation does today.
  • Build for regulated ground truth: work hand in hand with legal, compliance, and SST domain experts to make sure the product is correct on NR-01, eSocial, and psychosocial-risk requirements before it is fast or delightful. In this market, compliance failures are not a bug, they are existential.
  • Drive planning and measurement: set OKRs, goals, and success metrics for the bet jointly with the Founder/GM, and report progress in a way that is honest about what's working and what isn't.
  • Work close to the customer: get in front of HR and SST buyers, clinics, and brokers yourself, alongside the commercial team, so product decisions are grounded in what you've heard directly, not what's been relayed to you.
  • Lead design and engineering execution: run backlog, rituals, and delivery with your design and engineering craft leads, keeping a small team focused and shipping weekly, not planning for a quarter.
  • Bring judgment in ambiguity: make calls with incomplete information, defend the ones that matter, and change your mind fast when the evidence says to.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including time spent building a product from zero to one.
  • Experience in, or close proximity to, a highly regulated or compliance-heavy market (health, insurance, benefits, HR tech, occupational safety, or similar), and comfort making product calls where "move fast" has real limits.
  • Genuinely AI-native: you reach for AI as the default way to do more with less, direct agents to compress manual work, and are comfortable being a beginner on things AI changes every month.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills: able to use data and metrics to generate insight, prioritize ruthlessly, and know what to measure when the business itself is still being defined.
  • Entrepreneurial and self-driven, with a bias to ship and sell as the way to learn, balanced with the judgment to know which corners cannot be cut.
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook: this bet doesn't have an established product organization or years of process behind it; you'll help build both as you go.
  • Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

Death is our only foe.

Immortals was founded by Bryan Johnson, who has the world’s best comprehensive biomarkers. He is quantitatively the healthiest person on the planet.

Immortals is methodically built on science. Bryan freely shares his protocol, learnings and data with everyone to use. Immortals has also developed a family of nutritional products to make the benefits of the Blueprint protocol affordable and available to all.

We’re a small, tight-knit team working to clean up the global food supply, provide healthy food to everyone, and build Don’t Die into the most influential ideology in the world. We move quickly, work efficiently, and enjoy an environment defined by competence.

We are seeking a rare, hands-on leader who can operate at the intersection of high-scale systems and high-velocity commercial growth. As the VP of Product, you will lead the product and design vision for Immortals’ digital experiences, ensuring our technical foundation is modular and scalable while driving user acquisition and monetization.

A core mission for this role is creating a new, unified AI interaction experience that seamlessly ties together our commerce (supplements and meds), biomarker data, and our passionate community. This experience is designed to help deliver the best personalized solutions and recommendations to improve our users’ longevity and health. You aren't just a people manager; you are a "player-coach" who remains deeply hands-on in the product management process, leveraging AI assistance to drive 10x productivity and execution.

Requirements

Position Responsibilities:

1. Commercial Growth, E-commerce & Community

  • Full-Solution E-commerce: Optimize the purchase and renewal experience for our total health solutions, including supplements, prescription medicines, and biomarker testing.
  • Community Ecosystem: Foster and build the digital infrastructure for our community of users who care for each other’s health as much as their own.
  • Revenue Alignment: Partner with Sales and Marketing to optimize the "Product-Led Growth" (PLG) funnel and expansion.
  • Retention Economics: Use behavioral data and community loops to build "sticky" products that increase Lifetime Value (LTV).

2. The Unified AI Experience & Platform

  • Next-Gen AI Interaction: Lead the design and delivery of an AI-driven interface that synthesizes biomarker results, product recommendations, and community insights into a single, intuitive user experience.
  • System Scalability: Work with Engineering to ensure our data and AI layers support rapid third-party integrations and global scale.
  • Technical Debt Management: Make high-judgment calls on when to refactor for stability versus when to sprint for market impact.

3. Hands-on Execution & Leadership

  • Player-Coach Mentality: Run the product management process end-to-end—from discovery to shipping—while building and leading a high-performing team.
  • AI-Assisted Workflow: Champion the use of AI tools within the product organization to accelerate research, documentation, and design.
  • Strategic Conviction: Pivot quickly based on new information while having the data-backed conviction to protect the core product path.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a VP or senior leadership role.
  • Hands-on Expert: Demonstrated ability to remain "in the weeds" of product execution while managing an organization.
  • B2C Scale: Proven track record scaling products from 0 to 1 and managing millions of users.
  • AI Fluent: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, agents, coding assistants) in your personal and professional workflow.
  • Proven track record leading both product management and design teams simultaneously.

Preferred Skills:

  • Health E-commerce: Experience in B2C companies selling complex physical/digital health solutions (supplements, pharmaceuticals, or lab testing).
  • Community Building: Experience building or managing digital communities focused on shared goals or identity.
  • AI UX Innovator: Experience creating novel, non-traditional user interfaces driven by AI and data synthesis.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, or personalization-driven digital products.
  • Passion for longevity, health optimization, or the Immortals mission.

Benefits

Salary Range: $220-265k + equity + benefits

About the Company

At Rezilient, we’re redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before. Through our innovative CloudClinic model, we combine virtual provider visits with smart, tech-enabled infrastructure to deliver timely, personalized care. By removing traditional barriers to access and continuously expanding our specialty offerings, we’re building a healthcare experience that’s as convenient as it is comprehensive.

About the Role

We are seeking a Sr. Product Manager to support the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the products that power Rezilient’s care model, with a particular focus on the member experience in and out of the clinic. This person will sit at the intersection of clinical operations, engineering, and the business, turning real member needs into products and features that make a delightful care experience easier to access and more engaging.

As Rezilient scales across new employers, health systems, and markets, this role will bring structure and focus to how product decisions get made: defining problems clearly, prioritizing against measurable outcomes, and shipping in close partnership with Engineering, Clinical Operations, Customer Success, and Sales. The role will also help shape how Rezilient applies AI in care delivery.

Success in this role looks like a clear and trusted roadmap, fast and higher-quality releases, and measurable gains in member engagement and outcomes. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable setting product direction with leadership and working through requirements and edge cases with engineers, and brings sound judgment to a regulated healthcare environment where the ability to both move fast and “do no harm” matter.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Rezilient member experience, aligning priorities with company goals and customer commitments.
  • Translate input from leadership, clinical teams, customers, and data into a prioritized roadmap with clearly defined outcomes.
  • Communicate roadmap decisions and tradeoffs to stakeholders at every level, from executives to front-line care teams.
  • Ensure products meet HIPAA, security, and healthcare regulatory requirements in partnership with Compliance and Engineering.

Discovery & Requirements

  • Lead product discovery with members and internal stakeholders to understand workflows and pain points.
  • Write clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that Engineering and Design can build against.
  • Partner with Design on user flows, prototypes, and usability testing to validate solutions before and after launch.

Delivery & Launch

  • Partner with Engineering to plan sprints, manage the backlog, and keep delivery on track against committed timelines.
  • Work with Product Operations and QA to ensure releases are well tested, documented, and ready for internal teams.
  • Own launch planning with Clinical Operations, Customer Success, and Implementation so new features roll out smoothly.

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

  • Define product KPIs around member activation, engagement, utilization, and app store reviews, and track them on a consistent cadence.
  • Use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities and measure impact.
  • Share regular product updates and insights with leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Raise the bar for product practice across the team by sharing frameworks, templates, and best practices that help the product function scale.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a product or product area from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or consumer health industry.
  • Shipped and scaled at least one consumer mobile health, wellness, or fitness app with a large active user base, with strong product instincts for onboarding, engagement, and retention.
  • Experience building AI or machine learning features into a product.
  • Fluency with AI-enabled productivity tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where direct human research and review remain necessary.
  • Strong skills in writing requirements, prioritizing a backlog, and working day to day with engineering and design teams.
  • A data-driven approach, with comfort defining success metrics and using analytics to guide decisions.
  • Sound judgment and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-growth startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, and healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
  • Experience with employer benefits, health plans, or B2B2C healthcare models.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Notion, Figma, and product analytics platforms.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our members
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments

About Enara

Enara is a world renowned obesity and medical weight loss start-up, based in Silicon Valley, pioneering the use of data, digital, and clinical treatments to provide personalized plans with measurable results. Enara was founded by people from Stanford, UCSF, Kaiser, ClassPass & Evernote. Our mission is to develop the first ever platform to scale obesity treatment. Our platform allows for the latest breakthroughs in nutrition, exercise, and obesity science to be optimized and delivered in a series of personalized and programmable experiences. Our solutions are disseminated through unified products and services we deploy for the healthcare ecosystem; with a current focus on small to medium sized medical groups and clinics. Our platform has served over 2000 members and delivers world leading 16%+ weight loss sustained over 3 years. We deliver life changing care to members and we are redesigning the clinic-patient . We are backed by , , VSC, Continuum Ventures, as well as many prominent angels in Silicon Valley.

Team Values

1. Empathy (First)- Every patient’s journey is unique, and we approach each with compassion and understanding, always treating patients with dignity.
2. Empowerment (Through Partnership) - Patients are partners in their health journey. We strive to educate, motivate, and support them at every step.
3. Respect for Diversity- We embrace and honor the unique backgrounds, cultures, and identities of every individual, fostering an environment of inclusion and understanding.
4. Innovation (for Change) - We’re committed to challenging the status quo in healthcare, advancing technology and protocols to create sustainable health outcomes.
5. Service - Heart of Service - With humility and purpose, we dedicate ourselves to serving others, putting compassion and commitment at the heart of everything we do.

The Role: A Catalyst for Vision and Execution

  • We are seeking a Senior Product Manager who operates with a unique duality. You will not only be the architect of our product vision—defining what we build—but you will also serve as a Team Catalyst for the Product and Tech organizations, defining how we execute delivery.
    • This role requires a leader who can drive execution and accountability within our squads while providing mentorship and setting the bar for product excellence. You will sit at the nexus of clinical efficacy and software delivery, ensuring that we are solving the right problems for our three core stakeholders: the Patient, the Provider, and the Administrator.

Key Responsibilities

  • 1. Delivery Catalyst & Team Accountability
    • Cultural Leadership: Act as a role model within the Product and Tech organization. Foster a culture of high accountability, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
    Process & Execution: Own the "rhythm of business" for the engineering squads. Ensure that sprints are planned effectively, blockers are removed, and velocity is maintained without sacrificing quality.
    Mentorship & Quality: Provide hands-on mentorship and support to engineering and product associates, helping the team connect their daily code to the broader clinical mission and ensuring the highest quality product delivery.
    Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the bridge between clinical operations and technology, ensuring that the "why" behind every feature is understood by the engineers building it.
  • 2. Product Vision & Clinical Execution
    • The Clinical Ecosystem: Design and manage product lifecycles that account for the complex interplay between:
    Patients: Creating engaging, empathetic interfaces that drive adherence and behavioral change.
    Providers: Building tools that reduce burnout, streamline clinical workflows, and provide actionable data at the point of care.
    Administrators: Ensuring robustness in billing, reporting, compliance, and operational efficiency.
    Roadmap Strategy: Translate high-level company goals into a prioritized roadmap. You must be ruthless in prioritization, balancing new feature innovation with technical debt and operational stability.
    Data-Driven Iteration: Define success metrics (KPIs) built around clinical outcomes and user engagement. Use data to validate hypotheses and pivot when necessary.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 6-8+ years of progressive Product Management experience, with a minimum of 4 years specifically in Digital Health or Clinical Technology.
  • US Healthcare System Insight: Required residency in the US for at least 10 years, demonstrating deep practical knowledge of US clinical payment, regulatory, and operational environments (EMR, HIPAA, provider credentialing, etc.).
  • The "Clinical" Trifecta: Proven experience shipping products that serve the distinct needs of Patients, Providers, and Administrators. You understand EMR integrations, clinical workflows, and HIPAA compliance.
  • Leadership Trajectory: Experience managing agile ceremonies and driving accountability in engineering teams. You have a track record of improving team performance and morale.
  • Technical Fluency: You don’t need to write code, but you must be able to debate technical trade-offs with engineers and understand the implications of architectural decisions.
    • - Proven experience building with AI tools (e.g., LLM integrations, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted development workflows).
    - Proficiency in no-code/low-code platforms (e.g., Zapier, Bubble, Retool, or Airtable) to build internal tools or MVPs rapidly.
  • Communication: You can speak "Doctor," "Engineer," and "Business" fluently, switching contexts without friction.
  • Language: You are bilingual and able to work in Spanish via our Chilean Engineering team.

Qualities That Will Make You Successful Here

  • Empathy: You understand that behind every data point is a patient trying to change their life and a provider trying to help them.
  • Grit: You are willing to get into the weeds to unblock a release, but you know when to pull back and look at the horizon.
  • Ownership: You take personal responsibility for the success of the product and the health of the team.
  • Proactivity: You anticipate challenges, propose solutions before problems escalate, and drive initiative across the product lifecycle.

Why Join Enara?

  • Mission-Driven: Work on a product that tangibly extends and improves human life.
  • Impact: Influence the culture and processes of a growing tech organization.
  • Growth: Opportunity to shape the future of metabolic health technology.

Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Job Description

The Product Manager at FuzeRx is an individual contributor responsible for defining and delivering product initiatives that advance patient care, pharmacy operations, and strategic growth. This role sits within the Product Management job family and will support our Care and Partnerships teams.

As a Product Manager, you will own the roadmap for your product area, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Clinical, Pharmacy Operations, Data, and Business stakeholders to solve meaningful problems for patients and partners. You'll operate with increasing autonomy — driving discovery, prioritization, and execution end-to-end within your domain — while collaborating with senior product leaders on strategy and measurable outcomes aligned with FuzeRx's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own delivery of product features end-to-end — from requirements and design through launch and iteration — within a defined product strategy

  • Translate business, clinical, and operational needs into clear, concise product requirements and specs, partnering with Engineering, Design, and Data

  • Drive feature discussions with customers, engineers, and cross-functional partners (e.g., Clinical, Compliance, Finance), seeking direction from senior product leaders when navigating ambiguity

  • Support product discovery through customer research, data analysis, and validation to ensure features solve real user problems

  • Monitor feature-level success metrics (KPIs, adoption, usability) and use insights to iterate; may own OKR/QBR reporting for your area

  • Optimize roadmap intake — triaging features, bugs, and requests — and connect engineering work to the end-user experience

  • Understand the technologies in your product area; articulate technical requirements and flag risks in design choices

  • Build awareness of regulatory and operational constraints in healthcare and pharmacy, escalating compliance considerations early

Required Experience & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Management or a product-adjacent role (e.g., program management, clinical operations, analytics)

  • Experience shipping product features in partnership with Engineering teams in agile environments

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product metrics (KPIs, adoption, usability) to inform decisions

  • Clear, concise communication skills — able to write effective specs and drive feature discussions with engineers, customers, and cross-functional partners

  • Ability to identify technical risks and articulate technical requirements for features and APIs

About the role

Thatch is rewiring how health benefits work. We build software that gives employees real control over how they use their benefits.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own one of the core product areas at Thatch. Product teams are organized around the people who use our product, whether that's members, employers, brokers, or partners. Each PM owns their surface end-to-end, from strategy and prioritization through execution and continuous improvement.

Some of the hardest problems we solve aren't just product problems. They're operational, financial, and technical. You'll work closely with engineering, design, operations, and go-to-market teams to build products that are simple for customers, reliable at scale, and easy to trust.

You'll own real customer problems, make difficult tradeoffs, and help shape one of the most important parts of the Thatch product over time.

What you will do

  • Own a product surface end-to-end, from strategy and prioritization through execution and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to build products that are intuitive, reliable, and scalable.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and improve the customer experience.
  • Work across engineering, operations, finance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve complex customer and business problems.
  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear plans and help the team make thoughtful product decisions.

What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of product management experience with a track record of owning products or product areas end-to-end.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason through complex workflows, edge cases, and tradeoffs.
  • Technical fluency that allows you to partner effectively with engineers on architecture and implementation decisions.
  • Experience working across functions to solve operationally complex problems.
  • Strong communication skills and sound judgment when working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience that stands out

  • Building products in healthcare, benefits, fintech, or another regulated industry.
  • Owning billing, payments, ledgers, or other money movement systems.
  • Improving operational workflows or internal tools that reduce manual work or increase reliability.
  • Defining a strategy for an early or ambiguous product area.

How we work

  • We give people ownership and trust them to make good decisions.
  • We move quickly, learn from customers, and improve continuously.
  • We solve hard problems together, regardless of team or title.
  • We care more about building the right thing than following a perfect process.

What to expect

We aim to keep the process thoughtful, rigorous, and efficient. Most candidates complete it within three weeks. You can expect:

  • An initial conversation with a recruiter.
  • A conversation with the hiring manager, including a product review discussion.
  • Conversations with product, engineering, design, and cross-functional teammates.
  • A final conversation with executive leadership.
